name: video-ads-claude-code-codex
title_zh: 双AI互审出片，从策略到成片一条龙
tagline_zh: Claude Code 发起，Codex 当第二副驾。策略、钩子、脚本、分镜、配音、音乐、剪辑、复盘全包。
tagline_en: Launch from Claude Code, co-pilot with Codex. Strategy, hooks, scripts, storyboards, voice, music, assembly.
desc_en: Complete a video advertising mission jointly with real Claude Code and Codex, launched from Claude Code. Includes the integrated second brain, retention research, hooks, scripts, storyboards, voice, music, generation prompting, assembly, cross-review and campaign learning. Use when both assistants are requested for video ad work.
why_zh: 两个模型各写一半再互审，等于每版产出都过两道不同脑回路；内置第二大脑沉淀每次投放教训，越用越懂你的产品。
why_en: Two models draft and cross-review each other's work, so every deliverable passes two distinct reasoning paths. Built-in second.
limit_zh: 必须本机装好 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个 CLI 且都登录可用；只做视频广告，不接图文或纯音频。
limit_en: Requires both Claude Code and Codex CLIs installed and authenticated. Video ads only—no static or audio-only. Output ends at an editable asset kit.
title_en: Two-AI video ad pipeline with cross-review
